items.title: Lattice energy and size of the ions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Lattice energy and size of the ions: a main subheading of 6.9.2 Lattice energy, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 132-132.

blocks.text: Figure 6.6 mein alkali metal halides ki lattice energies di gai hain. Data se saaf hai ke cation ya anion ka size barhne se lattice energy kam hoti hai. Ions bare hon to opposite charge wale ions ek doosre ke itne qareeb nahi aa sakte, aur un ki packing loose (dheeli) hoti jati hai.

blocks.alt: Lattice enthalpy / kJ mol-1 (axis -600 se -1100 tak, 0 tak break ke saath) ka graph halide ions F-, Cl-, Br-, I- ke against, jo neeche barhte size ke circles se dikhaye gaye hain. Paanch girti lines, har cation ki ek, aur baen taraf Li+ se Cs+ tak barhte size ke circles. Approx. printed points: Li+ -1043, -845, -801, -751; Na+ -910, -783, -732, -687; K+ -812, -710, -670, -637; Rb+ -768, -682, -644, -615; Cs+ -718, -650, -618, -593.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.6: Alkali metal halides ki lattice energies (kitab ki Figure 6.6 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har line ek cation (Li⁺, Na⁺, K⁺, Rb⁺, Cs⁺) ki hai, aur neeche F⁻, Cl⁻, Br⁻, I⁻ hain. Daen jayen (anion bara) to value zero ki taraf aati hai, yani lattice energy kam. Neeche ki lines (bare cations) bhi kam lattice energy dikhati hain. Sab se zyada LiF ki hai.
